name: Bot inbox
description: Compiles a weekday summary of which Grok Bots and group chats have activity you haven't seen, one line apiece, with a scan command for checking between digests. It's read-only by design — nothing gets opened, edited or marked, so triage remains your job.

official.title: Bot inbox by Wayne
official.description: A weekday unread digest for Grok Bots. Lists bots and group chats with new activity, one line each. Type scan anytime. Never opens, edits, or marks...
